bagPolicy.summary: Bags may not be larger than 14 × 14 inches; the venue’s prohibited list flags backpacks and oversized luggage.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The Hollywood & Gower lot next to the theatre is entered from Gower Street; prices vary by show and the lot is independently operated. Other lots and metered street parking are nearby.
